title: Normalize completeness and residue charts on the fixed stratum
statement: Let T be Noetherian, E/Q_l a finite extension with integral datum d_big, and g:S→T an immersion with S locally Noetherian and quasi-compact. Let d be an adic datum on O_E with ideal generated by the recorded uniformizer, and let c be a normalized IntegralResidueCoefficientModel on S [lem-weil-pbc-integral-residue-coefficient-model]. Set e = d_big.integralRingIso(g) followed by purCoefficientIso and c.completed inverse [def-weil-pbc-four-corners, lem-weil-pbc-integral-coefficient-completeness-transport]. Define F as actual derived inverse image along g followed by scalar restriction along e inverse. Suppose K is intrinsically complete [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-complete], C realizes its exponent-one reduction through finiteRingComparison, and an etale cover of S provides perfect constant residue models for C [def-weil-pbc-integral-stratified-perfect-models]. Then F(K) is intrinsically complete for the singleton uniformizer tuple, and there is an etale covering sieve of S on every arrow of which the actual completedAdicQuotientReduction(F(K)) is the restricted completedAdicDerivedChange(residueLisseConstantComparison) of a perfect O_E/d.ideal complex, exactly as required by [lem-weil-pbc-residue-lisse-perfect-lift]. This makes no assertion of integral perfect models or a pro-etale refinement.

proof.text: Choose the singleton lifted uniformizer tuple and apply wfComplete_iff_presentation to the source. stratumIntrinsicComplete_preserved for the immersion g gives the intrinsic unit on the stratum. Apply wfComplete_iff_presentation on S, then integralResidueCoefficient_complete. The existing raw pullback scalar comparison and pbcDerivedRestrictComp identify its object with integralResidueStratumPull(K), and naturality of the Koszul unit transports invertibility.
Apply integralResidueFiniteReduction at n=0 using the supplied eC. This supplies a single global isomorphism from actual completed residue reduction to the normalized finite inverse image.

Generate the etale sieve by the supplied cover. The small-etale covering criterion identifies its covering property with the jointly surjective ranges of that cover. A member factors through a cover generator. Apply integralResidueFiniteChart to that generator and its supplied perfect model. The already proved finitePerfectModelsRestrictIso_further pulls its slice isomorphism to the member. Restrict the global finite comparison to that member using exact derived slice restriction and compose the two isomorphisms.

theorem integralResidueStratum_input
    (T : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian T] (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E]
    (S : Scheme.{u}) [IsLocallyNoetherian S] [CompactSpace S]
    (g : S ⟶ T) [IsImmersion g]
    (d : AdicCoefficientDatum (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E))
    (hd : d.ideal = Ideal.span {Padic.coefficientExtensionUniformizer l E})
    (c : IntegralResidueCoefficientModel l E d S)
    (K : PbcCompletedDerived T (pbcIntegralDatum l E))
    (hcomplete : PbcIsIntrinsicallyComplete T (pbcIntegralDatum l E) K)
    (𝒰 : Scheme.Cover.{u} etalePrecoverage S)
    (C : CochainComplex
      (FiniteCoefficientModules T (PbcQuotient (pbcIntegralDatum l E) 0)) ℤ)
    (eC : Nonempty
      (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (((SheafOfModules.restrictScalars
        (AdicCoefficients.finiteRingComparison T
          (PbcQuotient (pbcIntegralDatum l E) 0)).hom).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj C) ≅
        (pbcCompletedReduction T (pbcIntegralDatum l E) 0).obj K))
    (hmodels : ∀ j : 𝒰.I₀,
      ∃ P : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (PbcQuotient (pbcIntegralDatum l E) 0)) ℤ,
        @DerivedCategory.IsPerfectRingComplex (PbcQuotient (pbcIntegralDatum l E) 0) _
          (HasDerivedCategory.standard _) (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P) ∧
        Nonempty
          ((finiteCoefficientDerivedPullback T (PbcQuotient (pbcIntegralDatum l E) 0)
            (𝒰.f j ≫ g)).obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj C) ≅
            (finiteCoefficientRealization (𝒰.X j)
              (PbcQuotient (pbcIntegralDatum l E) 0)).mapDerivedCategory.obj
                (DerivedCategory.Q.obj
                  (((constantSheaf (ProEt.topology (𝒰.X j))
                  (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (PbcQuotient (pbcIntegralDatum l E) 0))).mapHomologicalComplex
                      (.up ℤ)).obj P)))) :
    (∃ (ha : Ideal.span (Set.range (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦
        Padic.coefficientExtensionUniformizer l E)) = d.ideal),
      IsCompletedAdicDerivedComplete S d 1
        (fun _ ↦ Padic.coefficientExtensionUniformizer l E) ha
        ((integralResidueStratumPull T l E S g d c).obj K)) ∧
    (∃ V : Sieve (⊤_ S.Etale), V ∈ S.smallEtaleTopology (⊤_ S.Etale) ∧
      ∀ (U : S.Etale) (f : U ⟶ ⊤_ S.Etale), V f →
        ∃ P : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u}
            (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E ⧸ d.ideal ^ (0 + 1))),
          DerivedCategory.IsPerfectRingComplex P ∧
          Nonempty
            (ringedSiteDerivedRestrictionOfUniverses (completedAdicFiniteRing S d 0)
                ((toProEt S).obj U)
                ((completedAdicQuotientReduction S d 0).obj
                  ((integralResidueStratumPull T l E S g d c).obj K)) ≅
              ringedSiteDerivedRestrictionOfUniverses (completedAdicFiniteRing S d 0)
                ((toProEt S).obj U)
                ((completedAdicDerivedChange S (residueLisseConstantComparison S d 0)).obj
                  ((residueLisseDerivedConstant S
                    (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E ⧸ d.ideal ^ (0 + 1))).obj P))))
